# Lab 12.5: AutoML Models

## What We Are Going to Do
Train an AutoML classifier that searches models and features for you, and compare it with the hand-built models. AutoML training is billed per hour, so use the smallest budget.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Train with a 1-hour budget.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_automl
OPTIONS (
  model_type = 'AUTOML_CLASSIFIER',
  input_label_cols = ['income_bracket'],
  budget_hours = 1.0,
  optimization_objective = 'MAXIMIZE_AU_ROC'
) AS
SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Training takes about 1–2 hours in total, including setup.

4. **[Console] Read the model details.** Open the model and look at **Evaluation**. AutoML hides the chosen architecture, but the metrics are comparable.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Effort | No model or feature choices needed |
| Time | Hours, not minutes |
| Cost | Billed for training hours |
| Result | Similar or slightly better than boosted trees |
